## Problem

Describe the user, security, or operational problem.

## Solution

Describe the implementation and important tradeoffs.

## Security and tenancy

- [ ] Authorization is enforced in the API.
- [ ] Cross-user and cross-organization behavior was considered.
- [ ] Inputs, files, queries, and socket payloads remain bounded and validated.
- [ ] No secret, private data, token, or sensitive log was added.

## Validation

- [ ] Formatting
- [ ] Lint
- [ ] Typecheck
- [ ] Unit/integration tests
- [ ] Production build
- [ ] Browser/accessibility tests when applicable
- [ ] Migration and rollback/compatibility reviewed when applicable

## Evidence

List commands run and attach sanitized screenshots for material UI changes.
